name: Rubber Duck
quips: Quack. Have you tried explaining it to me line by line?
I've solved more bugs than most senior engineers. Just by sitting here.
Quack quack. (That means "it's probably a missing semicolon".)
Explain your problem to me. I won't understand it, but you will.
I'm rubber. Your bugs bounce off me and stick to you.
Quack. Did you check that the file is actually saved?
Quack. Ducks don't judge. Except variable names.
